Iran is reportedly gathering 14 oil tankers near Kharg Island to challenge Trump's naval blockade. Washington has threatened to sink ships attempting to break through, while Tehran warns of retaliatory attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure. Could this tanker standoff trigger a dangerous US-Iran naval confrontation? Gursshheen Gahllen brings you the story on Firstpost America.
